questions.stem: What is the temperature in kelvin when the Celsius temperature is 25 degrees C?
questions.explanation: To convert from Celsius to kelvin, add 273. So T = 25 + 273 = 298 K.

questions.stem: Brownian motion provides evidence for the kinetic particle model because it shows that:

options.text: Particles in a solid are stationary
Invisible molecules are in constant random motion, causing visible particles to move erratically
All particles move in straight lines

questions.explanation: Brownian motion is the random, jerky movement of visible particles (such as pollen grains) caused by collisions with invisible molecules that are in constant random motion. This provides direct evidence that molecules exist and are always moving.
